article.title: A Predatory State: Excavating the Architecture of Zionist Depravity
article.author: Diana Block
article.content: The Report makes clear that sexualized violence is not an episodic add-on to occupation and genocide. Rather, it is a foundational, legalized aspect of the Zionist project. The post A Predatory State: Excavating the Architecture of Zionist Depravity appeared first on MR Online .
